_note: Student interest + elective-rating survey for the elective recommender (owner: Ryan Kevena). Collected from volunteers; no grades or records are used.
title: Aggies Enroll - Elective Interest Survey
instructions: Pick the areas you are most interested in, then rate any electives you have taken or know about from 1 (not for me) to 5 (loved it). Skip anything you have not taken.

interest_question.prompt: Which areas are you most interested in? (choose any)

rating_question.prompt: Rate electives you have taken or know (1-5).

optional_free_text.prompt: In one line, what do you want to do after graduation? (optional)
